programs.title: Clika
programs.desc: When a clip of his performance goes viral, a small-town singer seizes the opportunity to carve out a place for himself on the music scene. Caught in a dangerous game, he must confront the choices he's made as he relentlessly pursues his dream.

programs.title: O'Dessa
programs.desc: A farm girl embarks on an epic quest to recover a cherished family heirloom in the post-apocalyptic future. Her journey soon leads her to a strange and dangerous city where she meets her one true love. However, in order to save his soul, she must put the power of destiny and music to the ultimate test.

programs.title: Asteroid City
programs.desc: World-changing events spectacularly disrupt the itinerary of a Junior Stargazer/Space Cadet convention in an American desert town circa 1955.

programs.title: Cyrano
programs.desc: Cyrano de Bergerac dazzles everyone with his ferocious wordplay and brilliant swordplay. However, he's convinced his appearance renders him unworthy of the affections of the luminous Roxanne, a devoted friend who's in love with someone else.

programs.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries
programs.desc: Aurora's boyfriend, Martin, reconnects with his long-lost niece, but she departs suddenly, leaving a dead husband on a balcony and a baby in a bathtub.

programs.title: Meet the Killer Parents
programs.desc: A young woman fights to escape her boyfriend's family after learning they're planning to groom her to replace their long-dead daughter.
